sentences.text: Joan of Arc -LRB- Jeanne d'Arc , -LSB- ʒan daʁk -RSB- ; 6 January c. 1412 -- 30 May 1431 -RRB- , nicknamed `` The Maid of Orléans '' -LRB- La Pucelle d'Orléans -RRB- , is considered a heroine of France for her role during the Lancastrian phase of the Hundred Years ' War and was canonized as a Roman Catholic saint .	Lancastrian phase	Hundred Years' War (1415–53)	Roman Catholic saint	Roman Catholic saint	canonized	Canonization

Joan of Arc was born to Jacques d'Arc and Isabelle Romée , a peasant family , at Domrémy in north-east France .	Domrémy	Domrémy-la-Pucelle	Jacques d'Arc	Jacques d'Arc	Isabelle Romée	Isabelle Romée	peasant	peasant

Joan said she received visions of the Archangel Michael , Saint Margaret , and Saint Catherine of Alexandria instructing her to support Charles VII and recover France from English domination late in the Hundred Years ' War .	Archangel	Archangel	Michael	Michael (archangel)	Saint Margaret	Margaret the Virgin	Saint Catherine of Alexandria	Catherine of Alexandria	Charles VII	Charles VII of France
The uncrowned King Charles VII sent Joan to the siege of Orléans as part of a relief mission .	Charles VII	Charles VII of France	siege of Orléans	siege of Orléans
She gained prominence after the siege was lifted only nine days later .
Several additional swift victories led to Charles VII 's coronation at Reims .	Charles VII	Charles VII of France	Reims	Reims
This long-awaited event boosted French morale and paved the way for the final French victory .
On 23 May 1430 , she was captured at Compiègne by the Burgundian faction , which was allied with the English .	Compiègne	Compiègne	Burgundian faction	Burgundian (party)
She was later handed over to the English and put on trial by the pro-English Bishop of Beauvais Pierre Cauchon on a variety of charges .	Pierre Cauchon	Pierre Cauchon
After Cauchon declared her guilty she was burned at the stake on 30 May 1431 , dying at about nineteen years of age .	burned at the stake	death by burning

In 1456 , an inquisitorial court authorized by Pope Callixtus III examined the trial , debunked the charges against her , pronounced her innocent , and declared her a martyr .	Pope Callixtus III	Pope Callixtus III	martyr	martyr

In the 16th century she became a symbol of the Catholic League , and in 1803 she was declared a national symbol of France by the decision of Napoleon Bonaparte .	Catholic League	Catholic League (French)	Napoleon	Napoleon
She was beatified in 1909 and canonized in 1920 .	beatified	Beatification	canonized	Canonization

Joan of Arc is one of the nine secondary patron saints of France , along with Saint Denis , Saint Martin of Tours , Saint Louis , Saint Michael , Saint Rémi , Saint Petronilla , Saint Radegund and Saint Thérèse of Lisieux .	Michael	Michael (archangel)	Saint Denis	Denis	Saint Martin of Tours	Martin of Tours	Saint Louis	Louis IX of France	Saint Michael	Michael (archangel)	Saint Rémi	Saint Remigius	Saint Petronilla	Saint Petronilla	Saint Radegund	Radegund	Saint Thérèse of Lisieux	Thérèse of Lisieux

Joan of Arc has remained a popular figure in literature , painting , sculpture , and other cultural works since the time of her death , and many famous writers , filmmakers and composers have created works about her .
Cultural depictions of her have continued in films , theater , television , video games , music , and performances to this day .	Cultural depictions of her	Cultural depictions of Joan of Arc
